headline: Dubuque’s ‘Clean’ FY2025 Audit Still Flagged $2 Million in Spending Beyond One Budget Function
summary: Independent auditors gave the City of Dubuque an unmodified opinion on its fiscal 2025 financial statements and reported no financial-statement or federal-award findings. But the audit’s statutory-reporting section found that community and economic development expenditures totaled $21,502,546 against a final budget of $19,476,722, exceeding the budget by $2,025,824. The auditors cited Iowa law governing municipal appropriations and recommended that the budget should have been amended before disbursements were allowed to exceed the authorized amount. The City said it would amend the budget in the future if applicable. The audit reported no questionable expenditures.
fml_kicker: The financial statements were clean. One budget line still treated its $19.5 million ceiling like a suggestion.
